    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data)

    ans = 0
    col = [False] * n
    diag1 = [False] * (2 * n - 1)
    diag2 = [False] * (2 * n - 1)

        nonlocal ans
        if r == n:
            ans += 1
            return

            d1 = r + c

            if col[c] or diag1[d1] or diag2[d2]:
                continue

            col[c] = diag1[d1] = diag2[d2] = True
            solve(r + 1)
            col[c] = diag1[d1] = diag2[d2] = False

    solve(0)
    print(ans)

    main()
